about.description: Resolv is a decentralized insurance protocol offering smart contract coverage and claims settlement on-chain. It enables tokenized insurance products with transparent reserve mechanisms.
about.registryInfo: Resolv Labs (BVI; founded 2023 by Ivan Kozlov & Tim Shekikhachev). Operates USR, a delta-neutral synthetic dollar protocol similar to Ethena, with ETH/BTC long-spot + short-perp hedge. RLP is the risk-absorbing token. Backed by Maven 11, Coinbase Ventures, Reverie.

fees.revenueNotes: Resolv earns the spread between gross strategy yield (funding + LST) and the stUSR pass-through rate, with excess accruing to RLP holders. Protocol-fee mechanism documented on docs.resolv.xyz.
